DIAGNOSIS READY: Bronchiectasis

The description of an 11-year history of chronic cough with copious amounts of thick, yellow-green sputum, particularly in the mornings, is highly suggestive of bronchiectasis rather than simple chronic bronchitis. REQUEST IMAGES: Chest_CT_scan
